headline: 🔴 Emperador ransomware hits Vietnam power grid, ⚠️ CoinBaseCartel mid-August wave hits 7 victims, 🎯 ShinyHunters breaches BOK Financial with Aug 24 deadline, 🛡️ Gemini CLI supply chain leads to GCP compromise, 📋 Apollo Global breach part of broader financial sector social engineering campaign, 🔐 768 leaked AWS keys still active with full admin
summary: Emperador ransomware struck Vietnam's largest power utility with a 300GB data exfiltration threat, CoinBaseCartel launched a mid-August campaign hitting seven organizations across four countries, and ShinyHunters breached BOK Financial with an imminent leak deadline.
